Madhya Pradesh Police Officers Suspended Over Hotel Harassment Allegations

Six police personnel, including an Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP) named Deepak Mishra, have been suspended in Seoni, Madhya Pradesh, following allegations of extortion and threats. A viral video purportedly showed police officers, including the Kotwali TI, harassing a couple at a hotel and threatening to frame them in a false case involving marijuana. The Chief Minister, Dr. Mohan Yadav, ordered strict action after reviewing the video. Patrika reported that ASP Deepak Mishra's name had also surfaced in the Seoni Hawala case, with an audio leak related to that incident.
